Alberta average class size in core subjects, by grade cohort, as published by Alberta Education. Taken from the department’s own table rather than recomputed from the class-level microdata: the published method excludes Colony and Hutterite schools, counts a team-taught class as several classes, and puts combined grades (a 3/4 class, for example) in the higher cohort. Recomputing from the raw file without those rules gives averages up to 1.5 students different.
source: Government of Alberta, Alberta Education. 2019 Class Size Initiative Review, Table 3: Class Size Averages. Guidelines are the 2003 Alberta Commission on Learning figures.
note: Reporting ended after 2018/19. Alberta Education no longer requires school authorities to submit class size data.
